messages:
liz_p: Heads-up — ACME pilot asks to top up their private marketplace commit mid-contract. Need routing + announce plan with HW partner and SI. Who owns the end-to-end?
sam_sales: Can we top up under the same PO or do we need an amendment/new private offer? They want +30% commit.
pranav_si: SI flag: their SOW aligns to current commit end. If we extend capacity we need an SOW amendment + co-marketing ask. They also want a 2-week joint announce window.
alex_field: Suggested flow: 1) confirm available Dedicated capacity 2) draft private-offer amendment (delta commit + pricing) 3) route to HW partner for kicker alignment 4) submit to Partner Portal 5) schedule announce cadence (2w embargo) 6) align renewal cliff to SI SOW.
liz_p: Good. Who picks up the Marketplace listing change / SKU mapping?
marketplace-bot: Note: private-offer amendments must go through Partner Portal. Example API snippet: ```PATCH /partner/offers/{offer_id} { "commit_delta": 0.30, "effective_date": "2024-11-18" }```
kate_pm: Legal review required for any pricing change or term extension (target 3 business days). Partner ops needs 48 hours to reconcile SKUs.
sam_sales: Pricing guardrail question — we should avoid adding a deeper discount band midterm. Propose we keep effective price same and treat topup as additive commitment, not a new discount tier.
pranav_si: SI asks for a hardware kicker: 10% rebate applied if they hit 3-quarter consumption milestone. That needs HW partner ok.
alex_field: I can draft the amendment template (commit delta + billing SKU map + renewal alignment). Will include a quick checklist for Partner Portal submission. ETA EOD.
liz_p: I'll loop in Legal + Partner Ops once Alex posts draft. @pranav_si can you confirm if SI co-marketing assets will be ready in the 2-week announce window?
pranav_si: Yes, we can deliver co-marketing collateral within 10 business days if HW partner signs off on logo usage.
kate_pm: Ops note — if we require bundling with HW SKUs (appliance/offline), that becomes a new private offer in the marketplace and adds ~5 business days.
sam_sales: For renewals: set an automatic renewal trigger sync with SI SOW end date so sales gets an alert 30 days before cliff.
liz_p: Plan owners: liz_p coordinate legal + partner ops, alex_field drafts amendment, pranav_si confirms SI assets and HW kicker feasibility, sam_sales confirms pricing floor and customer PO structure. I'll publish a short checklist here when draft is ready.
liz_p: Checklist draft posted: ```- Confirm Dedicated capacity (infra)
- Amendment draft (alex_field)
- Legal review (kate_pm)
- Partner ops SKU reconcile
- HW partner signoff on kicker
- Submit Partner Portal amendment
- Schedule joint announce (2w embargo)
- Set renewal trigger sync to SI SOW (alerts to sales)```
kate_pm: FYI — if legal requires contract redline, add +2 business days. Keep that in the timeline.
liz_p: Thanks all. Next sync: standup tomorrow 10am to close blockers. If anyone needs to escalate, ping me or post here and I'll route to partner execs. :thumbsup:
